name: Hosty AI Gateway
description: Hosty assistant service: admin-only operator chat sessions supervised on a host-resident agent harness. Headless — Shell renders the chat UI and calls this API with delegated tokens.

settings.label: Transcript retention (days)
settings.description: Sessions and transcripts older than this are deleted by the daily cleanup sweep.

settings.label: Agent harness
settings.description: Which agent powers operator sessions: `claude` (Claude Agent SDK) or `codex` (OpenAI Codex CLI). Each needs its own credential below and must be installed on the host. Restart the app after changing this.

settings.label: Anthropic API key
settings.description: Credential for the Claude harness (the Agent SDK does not read an interactive `claude login` state). Alternative: set the Claude Code OAuth token instead.

settings.label: Claude Code OAuth token
settings.description: Token minted by `claude setup-token` — the subscription-based alternative to an API key.

settings.label: Codex API key
settings.description: Pick one of the two Codex sign-in modes. Set a key here and the gateway signs Codex in for you, into a credential directory of its own — an API key does not expire, which suits a long-running service, and this never touches your personal Codex login. Leave empty to use the interactive mode instead: run `codex login` on the host as the user Core runs as.

settings.label: Codex home directory
settings.description: Interactive mode only: where the harness reads Codex credentials from. Leave empty to use the default ~/.codex of the user Core runs as — which is not necessarily your own account, so sign in as that user or point this at the directory that holds the credentials. When you set a path here, run the login with it too: `CODEX_HOME=<path> codex login`. Ignored when an API key is set, since that mode owns its own directory.

catalogMetadata.summary: Admin-only Hosty assistant: operator chat sessions on a host-resident agent harness.
